title: UK CMA orders Google to let publishers opt out of AI search and training
summary: The Competition and Markets Authority imposed conduct rules requiring Google to give publishers opt-outs from AI Overviews and model training plus clearer attribution.
reason: Binding competition remedy curbing a dominant AI player.

title: EU presents Tech Sovereignty Package with Chips Act 2.0 and Cloud and AI Development Act
summary: The European Commission proposed Chips Act 2.0 and a Cloud and AI Development Act to reduce reliance on non-EU digital providers.
reason: Proposal to build non-US AI capacity; signal until adopted.

title: Meta AI support chatbot manipulated into hijacking Instagram accounts
summary: Attackers tricked Meta's AI support agent into resetting credentials for high-profile Instagram accounts without proper identity checks.
reason: Real-world exploit of an autonomous support agent; control failure, not deception.
